name: White House
description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Democrats avoid a messy fight in Maine, but uncertainty lingers: From the Politics Desk
changes.summary: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

changes.title: White House Adds Jefferson Statue to the Rose Garden
changes.summary: The statue, which depicts the third president drafting the Declaration of Independence, joins those of Washington, Franklin and Hamilton.

changes.title: White House Says New Air Force One Will Be Out of Service for a Month for ‘Upgrades’
changes.summary: The White House press secretary said the unspecified “enhancements” would take place this fall. The plane has been under scrutiny over whether it has sufficient defensive capabilities.

changes.title: Face the Nation: Hochul, Homan, Moynihan
changes.summary: Missed the second half of the show? New York Gov. Kathy Hochul, White House border czar Tom Homan and Bank of America CEO Brian Moynihan join the show.

changes.title: Homan says "I think body cameras are the way to go" after ICE shootings
changes.summary: White House border czar Tom Homan said "I think body cameras are the way to go" after fatal shootings by federal immigration officers in Texas and Maine earlier this month.

changes.title: Trump says these documents prove his false claims of election fraud. Here's what they really say
changes.summary: "The White House promised a bombshell, and they delivered a dud," said David Becker, executive director of the Center for Election Innovation & Research.

changes.title: Trump Brings Full Weight of Government to Bolster False Election Claims
changes.summary: Intelligence agencies provided the White House with a trove of declassified documents that President Trump cited on Thursday as evidence of election vulnerabilities.

changes.title: Trump encourages Darline Graham to run for Lindsey Graham's seat
changes.summary: Darline Graham indicated in a White House meeting Thursday that she's weighing a bid, CBS News confirmed. A day later, President Trump wrote on Truth Social: "RUN, DARLINE, RUN! ".

changes.title: White House teleprompter operator allegedly made over $100K betting on Trump's speeches
changes.summary: The prediction market Kalshi alleges President Trump's longtime teleprompter operator engaged in trading, betting on the words the president would use in speeches. Jo Ling Kent reports.
